name: assert-api-multi-key-order-divergence
description: assertApi fails two body keys at once, declared out of alphabetical order, proving the failure message lists them in declaration order on both sides
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: assert api multi key
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "GET /api/profile as: profileRsp"
- assertApi:
    from: profileRsp
    body:
      "$.zzz": expectedZ
      "$.aaa": expectedA
